entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-09-12
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • The EF.Property<T> method may only be used within Entity Framework LINQ queries. #36761
  • Change Path.Combine to Path.Join in tools #36754
    Backlog

Closed

  • Possible issue with Entry().Collection().Query().Load() #35924
  • Is the SavedChangesAsync interceptor method meant to run before AcceptAllChanges? #35989
  • Is there a place to intercept just after flush data to database but before commit transaction? #36759
  • Failure when updating multiple properties on an item in a collection held in a JSON column #36726
  • Remove parent of an `OwnsMany` collection throws `SqlException` for `The INSERT statement conflicted with the FOREIGN KEY constraint "FK_PostSummaryTag_PostSummary_PostId"`. #35809
  • Consider allowing automatic wrapping of split queries in transactions #36755
    Backlog
  • "dotnet-ef migrations bundle" command broken on Linux with .NET 10 #36142
    10.0.0
  • Exception: Method not found: 'System.String Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.RelationalEntityTypeExtensions.GetContainerColumnName(Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata.IReadOnlyEntityType)' #36760
  • Cosmos: CUD batching #17308
    11.0.0

PullRequests

Created

  • [WIP] Error when moving a child object between parents #36772
  • Fix enum discriminator serialization inconsistency in Cosmos provider #36771
  • Fix Cosmos enum discriminator casting issue in CosmosReadItemAndPartitionKeysExtractor #36770
  • Fix FK dependency ordering when replacing owned entities with foreign key references #36769
  • Investigation: Nullable owned entity data preservation when moving between parents #36768
  • Fix thread safety in SingletonCosmosClientWrapper to prevent multiple client creation #36767
  • Fix ObservableHashSet bulk operations to handle entities with changing hash codes #36766
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #36764
  • [rc2] Add the threat model. #36762
    tell-mode
  • Fix handling of readonly fields using abstract classes (i.e. FrozenSet<T>) in parameters for primitive collections. #36757

Merged

  • [rc2] Fix dotnet-ef migrations bundle command on Linux #36750
    Servicing-approved, ask-mode
  • [rc2] Resolve query logger from QueryContext in shaper generation #36758
    Servicing-approved, ask-mode
  • Add transactional batch support to cosmos provider #36693
    community-contribution
  • [rc2] Disable Guardian Dotnet Analyzers #36763
    tell-mode
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #36745
  • Remove old SQL QueryBaseline.txt from tests #36756
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #36752

Updated

  • [rc2] SQLite: Make AUTOINCREMENT first-class and fix false pending model changes warning for value converters #36717
    ask-mode
  • [rc2] Introduce SqlEngineDbContextOptionsBuilderBase to allow unified registration of extension over SQL Server, Azure SQL and Synapse. #36737
    ask-mode
